div.p:
Tasks in Pre-startup do not call the Error Handler or user defined callbacks in general. This is because the full C environment is not yet set up when running in .init3, requiring careful
implementation of the source code, and to ensure quick completion of the Pre-startup sequence . Instead, any errors and the reset reason itself is stored in persistent memory (that will survive non-power related resets) using the Memory Manager. These values are read and handled later in the Startup Task Manager, when the full C environment is set up and optionally when peripherals required for handling is initialized.
